text:
The team note has it backwards. Savigny's Volksgeist holds that law grows out of a people's culture, history and customs, so "law reflects a society's culture" follows directly from it. The least likely statement is one saying law should be a universal, rationally designed code imposed from above regardless of a people's traditions. You didn't include the options, so that's my best guess at what they contain.

CONFIDENCE: 40
